structured.feedback: The description is about 220 words in Markdown, with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out the shutoff, stalling and warping complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the repeated "favorite scent" wording, the unsupported "compact" and the lack of any review use.
